patthana23.3:1.1: na kusalo na upādinnupādāniyo dhammo abyākatassa upādinnupādāniyassa dhammassa ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo:. ārammaṇe cha.
patthana23.3:2.1: na kusalaṃ na anupādinnupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato anupādinnupādāniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā pañca.
patthana23.3:3.1: na kusalaṃ na anupādinnaanupādāniyaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo anupādinnaanupādāniyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā cha. nakusalattika nasaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikattike kusalattika saṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikattikaṃ
